text: @pricewin/dsh 是面向 DSH Web 的旅行搜索结果卡片插件，通过 bundle 接入 PriceWin MCP 服务，并在浏览器界面呈现酒店与航班搜索结果。酒店卡片汇总不同来源的报价、评分、住宿价格和直订信息；航班卡片展示航线、时间、航空公司、经停与票价。它为搜索结果提供中文和英文标签、按浏览器地区格式化的价格，并可展开查看更多条目。用户可用配套旅行搜索技能发起酒店或航班查询、查看酒店详情及取消政策，也可提交合作酒店预订请求。适合希望在 DSH Web 中比较旅行报价的人；MCP 请求连接 mcp.price.win。

@pricewin/dsh adds hotel and flight result cards to DSH Web through the PriceWin MCP server. Hotel cards show ratings, stay prices, and offers from multiple sources; flight cards show routes, times, stops, and fares. The bilingual browser UI supports expandable results and partner booking requests.
想在 DSH 里比较不同网站的酒店房价和评价。
帮我查一段日期内的航班时间、经停和各来源票价。
Compare hotel prices from several travel sites inside the DSH web interface.
@pricewin/dsh 的功能「酒店报价卡片」：将酒店搜索结果整理为卡片，显示名称、地点、评分、整段住宿价格和不同来源的报价，并标出可直订酒店。搜索未完成时展示状态，结果较多时可展开列表。
@pricewin/dsh 的功能「航班报价卡片」：把航班结果按去程和返程展示，列出起降时间、航空公司、航线、经停、票价及来源链接，并支持展开更多航班。界面注明每一程为单独的单程票。
@pricewin/dsh 使用前须知：酒店和航班工具调用会连接远程 MCP 服务 mcp.price.win；配套技能说明预订请求还会提交住客姓名、电话和邮箱，以便合作酒店确认。

@pricewin/dsh README · PriceWin for DeepSeek Harness：Live hotel and flight prices compared across Booking.com, Agoda, Trip.com and
Traveloka, in USD, from inside [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness).
This is a DSH plugin bundle; its `cordis.patch.yml` adds three entries to the
profile:

@pricewin/dsh README · Result cards：In the Web UI, hotel searches appear as cards with the hotel's photo, rating,
whole-stay price, nightly price, and one chip per booking site, with the
cheapest marked. Flight searches list departure and arrival times, airline,
duration and stops, and every site's fare. Every price links to the site that
quoted it. Hotels that sell their own rooms through TravelOpen carry a
"Book direct · pay at the hotel" label. The model still receives the same text
results, and the cards cost no extra tokens.

@pricewin/dsh README · Result cards：- `lib/index.js` runs in the harness. DSH's MCP bridge passes only the text of a
  result to the browser, so this half adds a compact `presentationMeta` record
  of the hotels or fares to the four search tools (`search_hotels_live`,
  `poll_search_results`, `search_flights_live`, `poll_flight_results`).
- `lib/client.js` registers those four tool names in the `tool.call.toolview`
  slot and draws the cards. If a result has no such record, for example in a
  session from before the plugin was installed, the card shows the result's
  text.

@pricewin/dsh README · Result cards：Card labels follow the DSH interface language (Chinese or English), and prices
and dates are formatted for the browser's locale.

@pricewin/dsh README · Install：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @pricewin/dsh
```

or from GitHub:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:PriceDotWin/pricewin-dsh
```

Use the name of your profile in place of `web`. You can also add it from the
**Plugins** page in the Web sidebar. Then ask, for example:

> Compare hotel prices in Da Nang for 2 adults from November 10 to 12.

The tools appear as `mcp__pricewin__<tool>`.

@pricewin/dsh README · Install：Tested with DSH 0.2.1-rc.5 (`dsh --profile web`, hotel and flight searches
through the Web UI, light and dark themes). DSH is a preview and its
configuration format still changes; if a newer version refuses the bundle,
please open an issue.

@pricewin/dsh README · Tools：| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `search_hotels_live`, `poll_search_results` | Search a city's hotels across the OTAs and OpenTravel partner hotels; results arrive in two steps |
| `search_flights_live`, `poll_flight_results` | Search one-way or per-leg round-trip fares |
| `get_ota_hotel_detail` | Rooms, live prices, facilities and reviews for one named hotel (Booking.com) |
| `get_hotel_detail`, `get_hotel_info` | Rooms and prices, or facilities and policies, of an OpenTravel partner hotel |
| `get_cancellation_policy` | Refund terms for one rate |
| `request_booking`, `check_booking_status` | Send a booking request to a partner hotel and read its status |
| `request_cancel_token`, `cancel_booking` | Cancel such a booking, in two steps |

@pricewin/dsh README · Tools：**Booking takes no money.** `request_booking` sends the guest's name, phone and
email to the hotel, which confirms the request; no room is held and the guest
pays at the property. Cancelling needs a single-use token that is emailed to the
address on the booking, so nothing is cancelled without the guest's own inbox.

@pricewin/dsh README · What the bundle sends, and where：- **To `mcp.price.win`**: the arguments of each tool call, which are trip details
  (city, dates, party size, hotel name, price range, airports, cabin), a short
  excerpt of the request used only to pick the reply language, and, for a
  booking request, the guest's name, phone number and email.
- **Onward from PriceWin's server**: only to PriceWin's own backend and to
  OpenTravel's API (`api.travelopen.ai`), which the PriceWin developer also owns.
  A booking request's name, phone and email go to the partner hotel through
  OpenTravel, so the hotel can confirm it.
- **Usage analytics**: PriceWin records trip parameters only (city, dates,
  party size, hotel name, currency), never a guest's name, email, phone,
  confirmation code or cancel token.
- **Where prices come from**: PriceWin's backend reads Booking.com, Agoda,
  Traveloka, Trip.com and Google Flights from their public pages at search time.
  PriceWin has no partnership with those sites. Each result is labelled with its
  source and links to it for booking. Prices are time-sensitive.

@pricewin/dsh README · What the bundle sends, and where：No payment data is ever requested. See the
[privacy policy](https://www.price.win/en/privacy-policy) and
[terms of service](https://www.price.win/en/terms-of-service).

The same server and skill are packaged for Claude Code, Codex CLI, Antigravity
and OpenCode in
[pricewin-agent-plugin](https://github.com/PriceDotWin/pricewin-agent-plugin),
and for Pi in [pricewin-pi](https://github.com/PriceDotWin/pricewin-pi).
